summary: Zenkei Shibayama was a scholar in Buddhist studies and philosophy who taught Eshin Nishimura. He held posts at Otani University (~1948–1958) and Hanazono University (~1952–1967).
Zenno Ikuno worked in Buddhist studies and Indology. He earned an M.A. from the University of Tokyo and held a post at Asia University (attested 1982).

Zenno Ishigami studied at Taisho University (~1949–1956) in Buddhist studies and Indology, later serving there as professor and emeritus professor. He was president of Shukutoku University Junior College (2002–2014) and taught at Shukutoku University in 2014.

Zennosuke Tsuji worked in history, archaeology, Buddhist studies, and Japanology. After studying at the University of Tokyo (~1896–1899), he held posts there (~1906–1938), at University of the Sacred Heart (~1948–1955), and at Rissho University.

Zenryu Tsukamoto studied at Bukkyo, Shukyo, and Kyoto universities under scholars including Shinkō Mochizuki. A Buddhist studies and Sinology scholar, he held posts at Kyoto University (president 1949–1961) and Kyoto National Museum (director 1961–1972).

Zensho Kitagawa is a Buddhist studies scholar who taught Guohui Shi. He held posts at Rissho University (lecturer attested 1976; emeritus professor attested 2026) and the Nakamura Hajime Eastern Institute (attested 2026).
Zerkxis Bhandara works in religious studies and Indology. He was a graduate student (attested 2026) and held a post in Religious Studies at the University of California, Santa Barbara.
Zesho Machida worked in Buddhist studies. He held posts at Minobusan Okunoin Shishinkaku (attested 1990) and Minobusan University (emeritus professor, attested 1996–2001).
Zev Handel specializes in linguistics, Sinology, and Tibetology. He studied at Harvard College (1988) and UC Berkeley (1992, 1998), and became a professor at the University of Washington (~1999).
Zhao Luo works in Buddhist studies, history, archaeology, and Tibetology. He studied under Sen Wang and held a scholar post at the Chinese Academy of Social Sciences (attested 2014).

Zhaohua Yang specializes in Buddhist studies, Sinology, and religious studies. He held posts at Stanford University (attested 2007) and Columbia University (faculty attested 2018), and taught Kevin Buckelew.

Zhe Ji works in religious studies, Buddhist studies, and Sinology. He earned a Ph.D. in sociology from the School for Advanced Studies in the Social Sciences (2007) and served as associate professor at INALCO (attested 2011–2017).
Zhen Liu specializes in Buddhist studies, Indology, and Sinology. He completed an MA at the University of Munich (2005) and an MA at Lanzhou University (2009).
Zhengyan Fan works in Buddhist studies and Indology. He studied as a PhD researcher at Ghent University (attested 2026) and held a PhD researcher post there in 2026.
Zhenhua worked in Buddhist studies, having studied at Tianning Buddhist College (1947) and under Yinshun (1952). He was manager at Fuyan Buddhist Institute (attested 1992) and taught Chien Y. Hsu.

Zhihua Yao specializes in philosophy and Buddhist studies. He earned his PhD at Boston University (~1997–2002) under Malcolm David Eckel and held posts at the University of Hong Kong (~2003–2005) and The Chinese University of Hong Kong (~2005).
Zhiqing Wang works in Buddhist studies and philosophy. Wang studied at Lanzhou University (2006–2009) and at East China Normal University (2021).

Zhiru Ng specializes in Buddhist studies, Sinology, and religious studies. Ng studied at the University of Michigan (MA) under Luis Oscar Gómez and at the University of Arizona (PhD) under doctoral supervisor Robert M. Gimello.

Zhiru Shi studied at the University of Michigan and the University of Arizona under Robert M. Gimello. Specializing in Buddhist and religious studies, she held posts at Pomona College (attested 2007–2014) and Fo Guang University (attested 2026).

Zhiyi Yang studied at Peking University and Princeton University under Martin Kern. A Sinologist, she held posts at the University of Erlangen-Nuremberg and Goethe University Frankfurt (attested 2015; professor 2025).
